arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw a two-panel graphite staging storyboard, not finished art, for two distinct moments in an Ahmedabad evening produce market. Photo inputs are sole dog anatomy authority: 1 Neet side, 2 Neet frontal, 3 Buddy frontal, 4 Buddy side. Last image is rendered provisional model only. LEFT PANEL: Neet stands firmly with all four fine legs on cobbled ground beside a fallen bunch of bananas, looks proudly UP at a completely EMPTY wooden signpost above; monkey has already fled. Full narrow tan torso, visible neck, large triangular ears, tiny nub. No cabbage leaf yet. RIGHT PANEL: Buddy full side three-quarter body stands beside a seated older Indian woman on an overturned crate, his nose gently under her lowered hand. One tomato by crate and scattered tomatoes nearby; her faint relieved smile and his attentive face show companionship. Continuous moderately elongated Buddy trunk, substantial legs with clearance, tail slender. Woman provisional unreferenced appearance, plain sari, no Heather. Draw ribcage/pelvis/limb roots and weight contacts clearly in lightly visible construction lines. Two wide panels stacked vertically. No lettering, no extra dogs, no costumes, no food rewards yet. Setting readable, supported limbs, simple uncluttered silhouettes.

Use case: illustration-story. Finish a single wide full-page contextual story illustration. Warm evening Ahmedabad produce market, amber light and muted violet sky. Original photographs alone control anatomy. Use E001 max image ONLY for the flat smooth BODY paint treatment; do not copy Great Dane, park, relative scale, pose, floral collar or anatomy. Both dogs have truly smooth flat broad color shapes on torso, neck and thighs, NO small curly strokes, fur hatch, scalloped texture or raised shag contours. Buddy only has furnished muzzle/brows/hanging ears and slight paw fringe. Regional dark torso/eye surrounds, cream muzzle, light distal legs. No lettering. Render ONLY the TOP storyboard panel as a standalone illustration, no panels. Neet standing in four owned grounded fine legs beside fallen bunch of bananas, eyes raised seriously at the completely EMPTY signpost. Monkey has already fled, Neet guards bananas needlessly. Full narrow but substantial ribcage, modest head, large broad triangle ears, visible neck and tiny near flush nub. No cabbage leaf, no Buddy, no monkeys, no rewards. Preserve staging but give Neet the full torso of photos rather than overthin waist. Wide low viewpoint and sufficient market context, faint vendors in distance. Sign can stay blank. Exact beat after: He gave the post one final bark. Now they were.
